name: MASLD
remarks: Synthetic MASLD module for testing MASLD queries and automated coding. Built for PLHI Lab testing; not clinically validated.
v2: onset eligibility age 35; lab ranges vary by age group (<50, 50-64, 65+) so FIB-4 lands in the intended band; progression 2% per follow-up. Original kept as masld_v1.json.
MASLD (metabolic dysfunction-associated steatotic liver disease) module for synthetic testing.
Adults with cardiometabolic risk factors (T2DM, obesity, hypertension) get a higher chance of MASLD.
Each patient is assigned a fibrosis band (low / indeterminate / high / cirrhosis). Lab ranges for AST, ALT and platelets
are set so the FIB-4 score usually falls in the matching band, giving test cases for FIB-4 risk stratification.
Prevalence and stage splits are rough approximations for testing, not calibrated epidemiology.
